SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) FROM orders o
             JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id
             WHERE o.status='completed'
               AND o.order_date>='2026-01-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-04-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders o
             WHERE o.is_deleted=0 AND o.status<>'cancelled'
               AND o.order_date>='2026-07-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-08-01'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.id),2)
             FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id
             WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.is_deleted=0
               AND o.order_date>='2026-07-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-08-01'

SELECT c.region FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id
             JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id
             WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.is_deleted=0
               AND o.order_date>='2026-01-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-04-01'
             GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) FROM orders o
             JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id
             WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.is_deleted=0
               AND o.order_date>='2026-01-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-04-01')
             - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM refunds
             WHERE refund_date>='2026-01-01' AND refund_date<'2026-04-01'),2)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o
             WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.is_deleted=0
               AND o.order_date>='2026-03-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-04-01'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.mrr_cents)/100.0,2) FROM subscriptions s
             JOIN accounts a ON a.id=s.account_id
             WHERE s.is_trial=0 AND a.is_deleted=0 AND s.start_date<='2026-07-31'
               AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date>'2026-07-31')

SELECT COUNT(a.id) FROM subscriptions s JOIN accounts a ON a.id=s.account_id
             WHERE s.is_trial=0 AND a.is_deleted=0 AND s.start_date<='2026-07-31'
               AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date>='2026-07-01')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions s
             WHERE s.is_trial=0 AND s.start_date>='2026-04-01' AND s.start_date<'2026-07-01'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.mrr_cents/100.0),2) FROM subscriptions s
             JOIN accounts a ON a.id=s.account_id
             WHERE s.is_trial=0 AND a.is_deleted=0 AND s.start_date<='2026-07-31'
               AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date>'2026-07-31')

SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.amount_cents)/100.0,2) FROM invoices i
             WHERE i.invoice_date>='2026-04-01' AND i.invoice_date<'2026-07-01'

SELECT a.segment FROM subscriptions s JOIN accounts a ON a.id=s.account_id
             WHERE s.is_trial=0 AND a.is_deleted=0 AND s.start_date<='2026-07-31'
               AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date>'2026-07-31')
             GROUP BY a.segment ORDER BY SUM(s.mrr_cents) DESC LIMIT 1
